Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning fees for certain vehicle title, registration, and permitting services.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to fees for certain vehicle title, registration,and permitting services; amending RCW 46.17.040, 46.17.050, and46.17.060; and adding new sections to chapter 46.68 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.17.040 and 2011 c 171 s 55 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: ((A)) (1) Except as provided under subsection (2) of this section,the department, county auditor or other agent, or subagent appointed bythe director shall collect a service fee of: (((1))) (a) Twelve dollars for changes in a certificate of title,with or without registration renewal, or for verification of record andpreparation of an affidavit of lost title other than at the time of thecertificate of title application or transfer; and (((2))) (b) Five dollars for a registration renewal, issuing atransit permit, or any other service under this section. (2) A county may by majority vote of its governing board disapprovecollection of the service fee by its county auditor or other agent.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.68 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The service fee collected under RCW 46.17.040 must be distributedas follows: (1) If paid to the department, the fee must be deposited into thedepartment of licensing services account under RCW 46.68.220. (2) If paid to the county auditor or other agent, the fee must bedeposited into that county's general fund.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.17.050 and 2010 c 161 s 505 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Before accepting a report of sale filed under RCW 46.12.650(2), thecounty auditor or other agent or subagent appointed by the directorshall require the applicant to pay: (1) The filing fee under RCW 46.17.005(1), the license platetechnology fee under RCW 46.17.015, and the license service fee underRCW 46.17.025 to the county auditor or other agent; ((and)) (2) The ((subagent)) service fee under RCW 46.17.040(((2))) (1)(b)to the subagent; and (3) An additional fee of one dollar and twentyfive cents to thecounty auditor or other agent. A county may by majority vote of itsgoverning board disapprove collection of the fee under this subsection(3) by its county auditor or other agent.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.68 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The fee established in RCW 46.17.050(3) must be distributed to thecounty treasurer and credited to the county current expense fund.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.17.060 and 2010 c 161 s 507 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Before accepting a transitional ownership record filed under RCW46.12.660, the county auditor or other agent or subagent appointed bythe director shall require the applicant to pay: (1) The filing fee under RCW 46.17.005(1), the license platetechnology fee under RCW 46.17.015, and the license service fee underRCW 46.17.025 to the county auditor or other agent; and SB 5515 p. 2 (2) The ((subagent)) service fee under RCW 46.17.040(((2))) (1)(b)to the subagent.
